bio.text: Sam Liccardo represents California's 16th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, which stretches from Half Moon Bay and Pacifica to San Jose, Palo Alto, and Mountain View.
Before Congress he served two terms as Mayor of San José, and earlier worked as a criminal prosecutor and as a federal prosecutor in the Southern District of California.
He holds degrees from Harvard Law School, Harvard's Kennedy School of Government, and Georgetown University, and lives in Saratoga with his wife, Jessica Garcia-Kohl.
